summary: A Depth 20 subscribe: refused with the web adapter's words and status partial, nothing sent upstream; a Depth 5 subscribe after it streams the snapquote book.

notes: The web answers a Depth subscribe at any level but 5 with INVALID_DEPTH, its message alone reaching the client (pocketful_adapter.py subscribe, websocket_proxy/server.py subscribe_client); the desktop refuses it at admission with the same words (feed/refusals.rs).

deviations.reason: A snapquote carries no trade price, and none has come on the price stream yet: the web's Depth frame then has no ltp (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_snapquote_data); the desktop's keeps ltp 0.0 beside the book, as every broker's Depth frame does before the first quote (the 1.0.6 rule: the SDK's Depth callback reads ltp and timestamp).
